title: Summer Garbanzo Meal Prep
subtitle: Technical Formulation Sheet

meta.baseTargetScale: 3 Servings per formulation / 320 g dry bean base

summary: One kombu-cooked chickpea batch is split into two finished formulations: a high-acid Southeast Asian larb-style salad and an emulsified Mediterranean pasta salad bound with lacto-fermented pickle brine. Measurement basis throughout is mass in grams and component weight percentages.
scalingPrinciple: Item A.01 (Dry Garbanzo Beans) is locked at 100.0% and anchors the shared component baseline. Formulations 1 and 2 each restate their own local 100% reference — cooked bean mass and combined starch mass respectively — so each salad can be read independently, but scaling the sheet scales the whole meal-prep run proportionally.

formulations.title: 1. Component Baseline: Cooked Garbanzo Beans
formulations.intro: To ensure structural integrity and a deeply savory foundation, the garbanzos are prepared as a single uniform batch using a marine botanical input (kombu) to naturally enhance umami and break down complex sugars.

rows.name: Dried Kombu (Kelp)
rows.role: Glutamic acid source; enzymatic breakdown aid.

rows.name: Kosher Salt
rows.role: Internal starch seasoning; ionic structural stability.

formulations.note: Execution: Hydrate beans in excess water for 12 hours. Drain, rinse, and combine with the 1280 g water, kombu, and salt. Simmer gently until beans reach 165°F internally and are tender but completely intact (~45–60 minutes). Cool directly in the cooking liquor to prevent skin splitting. Drain completely before dividing: 400 g for Formulation 1, 350 g for Formulation 2.

formulations.title: 2. Formulation 1 — Southeast Asian Larb-Style Chickpea Salad
formulations.intro: A high-acid, herb-dense salad using rapid surface-area integration of aromatics to mimic traditional minced-meat larb profiles. Percentages here are relative to the 400 g cooked bean portion.

rows.name: Shallots
rows.role: Macerated in the acid base to denature sulfur compounds.

rows.name: Khao Khua (Toasted Sticky Rice Powder)
rows.role: Service-only addition; drinks up excess dressing and adds nuttiness.

rows.name: Fresh Herb Matrix (Mint, Cilantro, Thai Basil)
rows.volume: Whole mint leaves, torn basil, chopped cilantro

formulations.title: 3. Formulation 2 — Mediterranean Garbanzo & Pasta Salad with Dill Pickles
formulations.intro: An emulsified vinaigrette pasta salad engineered to use lactic-fermented pickle brine as an acidic binder. Percentages here are relative to the combined 530 g starch mass (beans plus dry pasta).

rows.name: Cooked Garbanzo Beans
rows.role: Component of the combined starch baseline.

rows.name: Dry Orecchiette or Campanelle Pasta
rows.volume: Boiled slightly past al dente (~400 g cooked yield)
rows.role: Component of the combined starch baseline.

rows.name: Dill Pickles (Lacto-Fermented)
rows.role: Matched to bean scale for uniform bite.

rows.name: Dried Sicilian Oregano & Fresh Herbs
rows.volume: Dried oregano, chopped parsley and dill

execution.name: F1 — Liquid Dressing Base
execution.text: In a large formulation bowl, vigorously whisk lime juice, fish sauce, and palm sugar until the sugar solids are entirely dissolved. Add minced chiles.

execution.name: F1 — Maceration Phase
execution.text: Add shaved shallots directly to the liquid base. Allow to macerate; the acid will partially denature the sharp allium sulfur compounds.

execution.name: F1 — Bulk Integration
execution.text: Introduce the 400 g of cold garbanzo beans, julienned carrots, and sliced celery. Fold comprehensively to ensure surface coating.

execution.name: F1 — Storage & Service Finish
execution.text: If packing for a 3-day window, store the base mixture in airtight containers. Do not add the khao khua, herbs, or peanuts to the bulk storage — pack these dry components separately. Just prior to consumption, fold in the khao khua, fresh herbs, and top with peanuts.

execution.name: F2 — Starch Handling
execution.text: Boil the pasta in heavily salted water. Cook ~30 seconds past standard package al dente instructions so the structure stays tender when refrigerated. Drain, do not rinse, spread on a flat tray, and coat with a fraction of the olive oil to retain surface starch matrix. Let cool to room temp.

execution.name: F2 — Emulsion Construction
execution.text: In an immersion blender cup or small deep bowl, blend the pickle brine, red wine vinegar, Dijon mustard, microplaned garlic, and dried oregano. Slowly stream in the extra virgin olive oil while whisking vigorously to create a tight, stable, creamy emulsion. Stir in the chopped fresh herbs.

execution.name: F2 — Bulk Fusion
execution.text: In a storage tub, combine the cooled pasta, 350 g garbanzos, diced pickles, celery, minced red onion, and cherry tomato halves. Pour the emulsified dressing entirely over the mixture and fold cleanly until thoroughly integrated.

execution.name: F2 — Maturation
execution.text: Seal airtight and place in cold storage. The pasta will absorb the pickle-brine vinaigrette during this phase. Top with fresh Pecorino Romano immediately before boxing or serving.

directive: In Formulation 1, the khao khua, herbs, and peanuts are service-only components. Packing them into the bulk container converts the toasted rice powder into paste within hours and collapses the entire textural premise of the dish.
